dedupe_keys.name: isle of man indicative flood risk maps river tidal and surface water

description: The Flood Management Division of the Isle of Man Department of Infrastructure publishes island-wide indicative flood risk maps on its IOMFloodHub website. The maps show the risk of flooding from rivers, from the sea (tidal) and from surface water as separate layers that can be switched on and off in an interactive map, with an address search by house name, road or postcode. The same site carries flood warnings, river cameras on the Laxey river, weather stations and guidance. Coverage is the whole Isle of Man. Access is free in the browser. Caveats: the page states the maps give a good indication of land at risk but are not detailed enough to set the flood risk of individual properties; the return periods and whether the layers can be downloaded were not stated on the page. Simulation uses: flood exposure screening of island infrastructure for river, coastal and pluvial flooding. Related records: the Polish ISOK flood hazard maps (data-poland-isok-hydroportal-flood-hazard-risk-maps) and reservoir flood extents for England (data-england-reservoir-flood-extents).
